overall_intent: Preserve reference face/hair and military unit life while making a quiet pre-formation cord adjustment legible in one naturalistic photograph.

attire_context.expressive_goal: A quiet shared preparation before formation, carried by service dress and the meaningful cord adjustment.
observable_targets: attached shoulder cord and smooth hanging loop
owner_relations: the main woman adjusts the cord carried by her comrade’s left shoulder
the background unit waits for both foreground members
required_constraints: reference main face and hair preserved
preserved_choices: the comrade’s patient attention to the same loop
open_scope: small contextual signs of unit routine
attire_context.role_focus: Military ceremonial attire used in a quiet pre-formation check: olive tunics, restrained metal collar insignia and an attached braided shoulder cord being settled by a comrade.
attire_context.scene_context: A reference-guided woman uses two hands to straighten a comrade’s shoulder-cord loop in a parade-courtyard entry while a measured formation waits.

grounds.quote: She settles a shoulder-cord loop on a comrade’s tunic while a formation waits.

review.rationale: The role is applicable through the already frozen military ceremony. It develops attire context within open role/appearance choices; observed reference face/hair properties remain protected. Cord, partner and setting are agent-owned staging, not new requester locks.
